components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Optional when structured address
            fields are supplied; otherwise this flat form is accepted for backward
            compatibility. On read it is the composed, normalized address — the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended
            when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of a structured postal address. Optional. When a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address',
            and it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded) and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of a structured postal address (unit, suite
            or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: A 4-digit postal code. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            stored and drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner addressed formally, derived at read time as the 'title'
                followed by a single space and the 'lastName', or just the 'lastName' when no
                title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read
                time as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The unified business identifier formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>', where REGION is the canonical region derived
                from the postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear') of the
                business-day-adjusted registrationDate, HASH8 is the first eight upper-case
                hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with
                lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Content-derived and carries no sequence number; a
                '-<n>' suffix is appended only to de-duplicate a collision. Assigned at
                creation.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold=true' to join an existing same-household owner; both
                housemates then carry the same value. Absent for owners not in a shared
                household.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one
                elapsed fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear').
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region, read at request time from the REGION prefix
                of the region-and-hash memberId so it always agrees with the identity.
                When no memberId is present it is derived directly, preferring the
                postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling
                back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                'registrationDate', derived at read time and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named after the calendar year it ends in (e.g. 15 June 2026 and 1 July
                2025 are both 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when more than 80 owners have already
                been created on the current business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner's city already holds
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the hard per-city capacity
                limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: Assigned at creation. True when this owner, though not a hard
                duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation
                (lowest matching id when several match). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner warrants a closer look
                for any of three independent reasons - 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares its base name with a known disposable
                provider such as 'mailinator.net' or is a subdomain of one), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formed as
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email segment empty when the
                owner has no email, the householdId segment empty when the owner is not in a
                shared household). Two owners may not share the same whole identityKey.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, derived at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when the owner has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Optional when structured address
            fields are supplied; otherwise this flat form is accepted for backward
            compatibility. On read it is the composed, normalized address — the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended
            when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of a structured postal address. Optional. When a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address',
            and it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded) and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of a structured postal address (unit, suite
            or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: A 4-digit postal code. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            stored and drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner addressed formally, derived at read time as the 'title'
                followed by a single space and the 'lastName', or just the 'lastName' when no
                title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read
                time as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner API surface this response conforms to.
                Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release, which groups the identifiers
                under 'identity'.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one
                elapsed fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear').
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region, read at request time from the REGION prefix
                of the region-and-hash memberId so it always agrees with the identity.
                When no memberId is present it is derived directly, preferring the
                postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling
                back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                'registrationDate', derived at read time and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named after the calendar year it ends in (e.g. 15 June 2026 and 1 July
                2025 are both 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when more than 80 owners have already
                been created on the current business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner's city already holds
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the hard per-city capacity
                limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: Assigned at creation. True when this owner, though not a hard
                duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Optional when structured address
            fields are supplied; otherwise this flat form is accepted for backward
            compatibility. On read it is the composed, normalized address — the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended
            when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of a structured postal address. Optional. When a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address',
            and it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded) and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of a structured postal address (unit, suite
            or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: A 4-digit postal code. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            stored and drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner addressed formally, derived at read time as the 'title'
                followed by a single space and the 'lastName', or just the 'lastName' when no
                title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read
                time as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner API surface this response conforms to.
                Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release, which groups the identifiers
                under 'identity'.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one
                elapsed fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear').
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region, read at request time from the REGION prefix
                of the region-and-hash memberId so it always agrees with the identity.
                When no memberId is present it is derived directly, preferring the
                postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling
                back to the city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                'registrationDate', derived at read time and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named after the calendar year it ends in (e.g. 15 June 2026 and 1 July
                2025 are both 'FY26').
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when more than 80 owners have already
                been created on the current business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner's city already holds
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the hard per-city capacity
                limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: Assigned at creation. True when this owner, though not a hard
                duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode while having a
                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation
                (lowest matching id when several match). Present only when
                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks it true while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner warrants a closer look
                for any of three independent reasons - 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the email
                domain is disposable-adjacent (shares its base name with a known disposable
                provider such as 'mailinator.net' or is a subdomain of one), or the city is
                over its soft capacity ('capacityWarning' is true) - otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, derived at read time as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id. Absent when the owner has no id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Optional when structured address
            fields are supplied; otherwise this flat form is accepted for backward
            compatibility. On read it is the composed, normalized address — the normalized
            'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended
            when an 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of a structured postal address. Optional. When a
            non-blank 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred over the flat 'address',
            and it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded) and returned in that form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of a structured postal address (unit, suite
            or apartment). When present it is normalized and appended to the composed
            'address' after 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: A 4-digit postal code. Optional; when supplied it must be four
            digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099,
            Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's
            range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and
            returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. Optional on create; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional courtesy title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            stored and drives the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: 'DR'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Write-only; not stored and never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

        - lastName

        - telephone

      title: Owner

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner addressed formally, derived at read time as the 'title'
                followed by a single space and the 'lastName', or just the 'lastName' when no
                title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, derived at read
                time as the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes
                from the left. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: The version of the owner API surface this response conforms to.
                Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release, which groups the identifiers
                under 'identity'.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Zero when the name was unique.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's loyalty points, derived at read time. Starts at 0,
                gains 2 when an email is present, gains 1 when namesakeCount is 0, gains 2
                for a household of 3 or more, and gains 3 for a tenure of more than one
                elapsed fiscal year (see 'fiscalYear').
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric loyalty level (1..4), derived at read time
                from membershipPoints. Maps membershipPoints to a level as 1 (0-1 points),
                2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more). Because a newly created owner has zero
                tenure, a new owner can reach at most 5 points and so never exceeds level 3.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical, user-facing region. It is NOT an identifier and never
                carries the version-2 tag embedded in the memberId's region; it is derived
                directly at request time, preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when neither
                resolves a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when 'membershipLevel' is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when 'locality' is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name for the owner's locality/region, derived at
                read time from the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region
                resolves to no table entry (e.g. 'UNKNOWN').
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, derived at read time. 'EMAIL'
                when the owner has a non-blank email, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived at read time from 'birthDate'
                measured against 'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from
                18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                'registrationDate', derived at read time and formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and

                2025 are both 'FY26').

              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true

              example: false
              readOnly: true

              description: Derived at read time. True when the owner's city already holds
                between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the hard per-city capacity
                limit of 50, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:

                different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:

              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matched at creation

                'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              example: false

            riskFlag:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true

              description: The canonical API path to this owner, derived at read time as

              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
